title: analytics: a filtered dataset measure asked on the cube door as `CUBE.MEASURE`, the name `GET /analytics/meta` lists, answers the unfiltered aggregate
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, a silent wrong number at a named location.
Reader: domain:spec / analytics seat, the next PR touching `packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts` (`compileClauses`, the per-measure `measureFilters` lookup) and `analytics-service.ts` (`namedQueryFields`, same lookup).
Dedupe (open AND closed): "analytics cube query measure named with cube prefix drops its dataset measure filter, unfiltered sum" → 10 shown of 31, none on this; "measureFilters lookup qualified member name cube.measure native SQL strategy" → 10 shown of 13, none on this.
Business reason: a dashboard or API caller that uses the member name `GET /analytics/meta` lists for a filtered measure (say won revenue) is shown the total of every row under that name, with no error, and makes decisions on a wrong number. If nothing is done, every client that copies names from `/meta` keeps getting it.
reach: measured at `AnalyticsService.query`, the handler `POST /analytics/query` calls (`packages/runtime/src/domains/analytics.ts`), on the native-SQL strategy (SQLite dialect), at main and at the branch of PR #25903 (#25778). In-process at the service, not over HTTP.
type: Bug

## What happens

A registered dataset with a filtered measure:

```ts
{ name: 'sales', object: 'deal',
  measures: [{ name: 'won_amount', aggregate: 'sum', field: 'amount', filter: { stage: 'won' } }] }
```

`getMeta('sales')` lists the measure as `sales.won_amount`, the `CUBE.MEASURE` spelling every cube member is listed under. Querying the cube door with each spelling:

| `measures` | statement run |
|---|---|
| `['won_amount']` | `SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN stage = $1 THEN amount END) AS "won_amount" FROM "deal"` |
| `['sales.won_amount']` | `SELECT SUM(amount) AS "sales.won_amount" FROM "deal"` |

The second answers the total of every deal under the name of the won-deals measure. Nothing is refused and nothing says the filter was dropped.

## Why

The member resolves through `lookupMember` / `declaredMemberEntry`, which strip the `CUBE.` prefix, but the measure's scoped filter is read as `datasetScope.measureFilters[measure]` with the spelling as asked, so the prefixed key misses. The read gate (`namedQueryFields`) uses the same key, so it does not judge the filter's fields either. That is not a bypass: the filter is not applied, so its fields are not read.

## Expected

The prefixed spelling answers what the bare one does, the filter included, or is refused. #25778's duration measures already resolve the filter by the bare key (`durationMeasureKey` in `duration-measure-sql.ts`). Ordinary measures need the same resolution at both lookups. The `DatasetExecutor` path is unaffected, because it builds bare names.

Found by the independent review of PR #25903 (dataset duration measure). It is outside that card's scope.
